answer: We can no longer deploy production on Fridays to prevent incidents following a previous Friday release issue [D1]. Previously, releases were scheduled for Friday afternoons, but this practice was changed on 2026-03-09 [D1, D2]. Consequently, ordinary release slots have been moved to Tuesday and Thursday mornings [D1].
